title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09

ai_review.summary: Fair matrix recording of a mixed‑energy show with standout Phil Lesh bass work and a memorable Stars & Stripes Forever ending.
ai_review.review: The performance swings between solid, harmony‑rich playing—especially Phil Lesh’s lush runs—and a generally lifeless feel that left some listeners underwhelmed. The matrix source is listenable but suffers from a harsh pan and vague vocal presence that required post‑mix cleanup. Highlights include the brief Stars & Stripes Forever tag and the overall strong setlist, though the show’s energy feels uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give an average of ~3.3 stars; positive comments about Lesh and setlist are offset by strong negative feedback on overall performance and some technical flaws, leading to a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Harsh pan and somewhat muffled/iffy vocals noted; reviewer applied extra reverb to improve sound. Overall listenable but not crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Inconsistent flow – strong opening and solid setlist contrast with a middle section described as lifeless by some listeners.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh's bass is highlighted as a standout, with lush runs, fills, and strong harmonic support.
